statements.markdown: Statement 8.2 (CongBound_at). Let ℓ be large, not exceptional, and different from the two auxiliary level primes of the host; assume two further conditions that we do not reproduce (WeightTie, HG), and let the Galois representations of the forms be given over the ring of coefficients by a family satisfying a third (GoodR). Let π ∈ Z, and suppose that the Galois representation of π is, over the fraction field, the sum of a representation ρ and the t 0 characters χ 1 , . . . , χ t 0 . Then the valuation at π of the congruence ideal is at most len Sel(ρ) + X 0<e<t 0 len ℓ (e) + v ℓ (h E ) + t 0 X v(ζ q − 1), q∈Q where Sel(ρ) is a Selmer group attached to ρ, h E is the class number of the host field and Q is a finite set of auxiliary primes.
